M4a — live Supabase, 27 Aug 2026, AFTER apply
Applied through the Supabase MCP as migration `m4a_ownership_and_roles`.

Every prediction met. No exceptions.

WHAT THIS FIXED, AND WHY IT COULD NOT HAVE BEEN CAUGHT LOCALLY

  _handover_owner() fell back to "the first admin by email". On live that is
  france@, because france sorts before lone. The M4 apply set the config by
  hand, which fixed the symptom; the fallback remained and would have picked
  France again the moment the key were cleared or the system stood up
  elsewhere.

  No local test could catch it: the fixture has Lone as the only admin, so the
  fallback returns Lone there and looks correct. tests/m4a-tests.sql now adds
  two more admins - one sorting BEFORE lone - so the fixture can no longer
  flatter the code.

WHAT DID NOT CHANGE, AND THIS IS THE POINT

  Nobody gained or lost a capability. is_ops_admin() was DEFINED as
  `select is_admin()`, so re-pointing its sixteen call sites at is_admin() is
  a no-op in behaviour. What changed is that the name no longer invites the
  conflation that produced the bug.

  France and Tshenolo keep admin. Assertions 18a-22 of the M4a suite prove a
  France-shaped admin still reads every contract, every handover and the whole
  support audit trail, and can still write a contract - measured against the
  true counts rather than ">= 0", which any stranger would satisfy.
